bloques.titulo: The future of probability or guess
texto: In Italian, the future is used very often to make logical deductions about a current situation that is not absolutely certain: **Sarà a casa** (probably at home / will be at home now); **Che ore sono? — Saranno le tre** (what time is it?

It is very common for estimating the amounts, prices or approximate ages: **Quanti anni ha quella ragazza? — Avrà vent'anni** (how old is that girl?); **Costerà circa cinquanta euro** (will cost about 50 euros).

filas: Acción posterior en el tiempo cronológico

frases.it: Dov'è Marco? Non lo vedo al suo tavolo di lavoro.
frases.es: ¿Dónde está Marco? No lo veo en su mesa de trabajo.
frases.en: Where's Marco? I don't see him at his work table.

frases.it: Sarà in riunione con la direzione o starà prendendo un caffè.
frases.es: Estará en reunión con la dirección o estará tomando un café.
frases.en: He'll be in a meeting with the management or he'll be having coffee.

frases.it: E chi sono quei due ragazzi all'ingresso?
frases.es: ¿Y quiénes son esos dos muchachos de la entrada?
frases.en: And who are those two boys at the entrance?

frases.it: Avranno circa vent'anni: saranno i nuovi stagisti del corso estivo.
frases.es: Tendrán unos veinte años: serán los nuevos becarios del curso de verano.
frases.en: They will be about twenty years old: they will be the new fellows of the summer course.

frases.it: Hai ragione: hanno iniziato proprio stamattina.
frases.es: Tienes razón: han empezado justo esta mañana.
frases.en: You're right: they started just this morning.

bloques.pregunta: What is the meaning of the «Dov'è Marco? — Sarà a casa» phrase?

opciones.texto: A reasonable conjecture about the place where Marco is in the present.
opciones.explicacion: The future of conjecture expresses probability or assumption over the now.

opciones.texto: The indisputable confirmation of a journey that Marco will begin next month.
opciones.explicacion: It does not refer to a safe future displacement.

opciones.texto: A clear order that forces Marco to leave for his house immediately.

bloques.pregunta: How is «Avranno circa vent'anni» interpreted by observing two young people?

opciones.texto: As a prudent estimate of the approximate age you have right now.
opciones.explicacion: The conjectural future with «avere» serves to calculate ages without mathematical certainty.

opciones.texto: As the formal promise that they will turn twenty years in the next century.
opciones.explicacion: It alludes to the present by a probabilistic judgment.

opciones.texto: Like the number of books they've acquired at the university bookstore.
opciones.explicacion: Expresses age by the «anni» temporary unit.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the epistemic future of «essere».
bloques.frase: Dov'è finita la chiave di casa? ___ nella tua borsa.

opciones.explicacion: A present hypothesis is formulated: «It'll probably be in your bag.».
It is a form of imperfect pretérito which the past is evident.
It is the near past, incompatible with the present doubt raised.

bloques.pregunta: What value does the future «costerà» have here?
bloques.frase: Quell'orologio antico costerà almeno trecento euro.

opciones.texto: Expresa una estimación aproximada del precio real en el mercado actual.
opciones.explicacion: «Costerà» calculates a pecuniary value without having the exact rate.

opciones.texto: He claims that the clock will increase its price next year by inflation.
opciones.explicacion: It is not a long-term economic prediction.

opciones.texto: Remember what the watch cost when it was made two centuries ago.
opciones.explicacion: It makes a hypothesis about the current value of the object.

bloques.pregunta: What does the use of «saranno» indicate?
bloques.frase: Saranno circa le otto di sera a giudicare dalla luce.

opciones.texto: Deducate the current approximate time from the surrounding tracks.
opciones.explicacion: «Saranno + hora» conjecture on the time in place at the time of speaking.

opciones.texto: It confirms the time with mathematical accuracy according to an atomic timer.
Set the time at which the alarm will have to ring tomorrow morning.

bloques.explicacion: Temporal conjecture present formulated with simple future in plural.

bloques.pregunta: How do you guess the reason for someone's tiredness now saying «You'll be tired.»?

opciones.explicacion: The future conjectural «sarà stanco» is equivalent to «He's probably tired.».
It reports for sure a state in preterito time.

opciones.texto: È stato stanco la settimana scorsa.
opciones.explicacion: It is a fact concluded in the past.

intro: It uses the simple future with epistemic value to make assumptions and conjectures about the present.
